description: Bumps the pinned compiler and the SHA-pinned actions (plan 2b, Decisions 20, 21).

packageRules.description: A bump is its own build(toolchain) pull request that a person finishes.
prBodyNotes: Finish this bump in the branch, then squash-merge it (plan 2b, Decision 20):

1. `TRYBUILD=overwrite cargo test -p a2ui-runtime --test reason_compile_fail`, then re-read each `crates/a2ui-runtime/tests/ui/*.stderr`: each must still fail with E0277 on the `Piece` bound or E0597 on the borrowed `document`.
2. Fix the new `clippy -D warnings` lints, then run `just ci`. CI's cache starts cold on the new rustc.
Renovate stops updating this branch once a person pushes to it: if a newer rustc ships first, close this pull request and Renovate opens a fresh one.

packageRules.description: Actions stay pinned to a commit SHA, the release in a comment; one ci(deps) PR for all.
